listing.name: Torchships and Deadly Armaments Unofficial Update
listing.summary: An unofficial update bringing Tartiflette's mod, Torchships and Deadly Armaments, to 0.98. Credit to Tartiflette as this is simply an unofficial update for one of his mods. Credit as well to Maxwell and Slavodan for the Owl (XIV) sprite added in this fork.
listing.aiSummary: Updates an existing ship and weapon pack to version 0.98.

description: Brings an older ship and weapon pack up to date for version 0.98. Includes minor adjustments to ship stats, spawn weights, and variants. Buffs the Herald ship with increased armor, hull, and operational points.

changelog.0.98:
Just some minor changes for the most part with the most notable probably being the Herald being buffed. Not sure if this is compatible with previous versions that I have released. I would suggest starting a new playthrough regardless.
 Adjusted some variants
 Changed FP stat for some ships
 Changed mass stat for some ships
 Changed value (in-game price) for some ships
 Changed some spawn weights for some pirate variants
 Changed MagicLib bounty name
 Changed showcase mission description
 Herald
 Raised armor to 1300
 Raised hull to 15000
 Added combat and no auto escort tags
 Changed its large ballistic weapon slot to a large hybrid slot
 Added operation center hullmod
 Added hist3t tag
 Raised OP to 315
 Bully
 Lowered DP cost of Bully (P) to 10
 Removed distributed fire control, also applies to its luddic path and pirate variants
 Raised top speed to 70
 Scalper
 Reduced DP cost of normal Scalper to 8
 Added high resolution sensors to normal Scalper
 DEM variant should now be Persean League only though it should still be visible in autofit
 Raised top speed to 90
 Owl
 Raised shield arc to 150
 Added hist2t tag to Owl (XIV)
 Removed ECM package
 Raised hullpoints of Lasher (TT) to 1500
 Raised hullpoints of Tempest Mk.2 to 1250
